Class SmartDateParser_v2.DatePattern

  • java.lang.Object
    • util.SmartDateParser_v2.DatePattern
  • Enclosing class:
    SmartDateParser_v2

    private static final class SmartDateParser_v2.DatePattern
extends java.lang.Object
    Pairs a regex shape check with the immutable formatters to try for it: first one with an optional 24-hour time (which also covers date-only input), then one with a mandatory 12-hour time and AM/PM marker.
